scripts.lint:fix: turbo run lint:fix && bun run lint:root --write
scripts.test: for dir in packages/infra packages/meeting-mode packages/stt apps/control apps/desktop apps/realtime apps/workers; do files=$(find $dir -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.integration.test.ts' ! -name '*.e2e.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -type f); if [ ! -z "$files" ]; then bun test $files || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.test:integration: for dir in packages/infra packages/meeting-mode apps/control apps/realtime; do files=$(find $dir -name '*.integration.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -type f); if [ ! -z "$files" ]; then bun test $files || exit 1; fi; done
